info.title: Demat Escrow API
info.description:
Learn how to integrate Demat Escrow into your app. This reference covers the **secret-key API**, the same operations you can run from the merchant dashboard, callable from your backend.

> **Before you begin**
> Create a merchant account in the Demat dashboard, complete onboarding, and copy your **test secret key** (`sk_test_...`). Use test keys until your account is verified and you are ready to go live.

The Escrow API is a RESTful, JSON API. Most routes require authentication. Use it to create customers, hold funds in escrow, release or refund those funds, manage wallets, start checkout, and send payouts.

All requests must be made over **HTTPS**. Unencrypted HTTP is not supported in production.
